text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging oncall — GPU prefill OOMs observed causing container restarts in cluster-us-west-2. Error rate spike ~12% for /generate with long-context. Detected on nodes gpu-node-17,gpu-node-21.

mike-oncall: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and will triage.

lana-sre: I'm seeing repeated container restarts on runtimes prefilling >8k tokens. OOM followed by SIGKILL.

dmitri-ml: paste of latest container log:
```
[2026-03-17T08:14:52Z] runtime.cc:431 allocate failed: CUDA error: out of memory
kvcache.cpp:210 evict chain 0x7ff..
*** Restarting container: exit code 137
```

mike-oncall: confirmed. impact: customers using long-window chat + batch prefill. 5xx spike correlates with requests > 6000 tokens.

emily-cs: which customers? need to draft incident banner if customer-facing latency/5xx persists.

lana-sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon+drain overloaded nodes 2) enable prefill-shed (trim prefill to 4096 tokens) 3) route new long-context requests to fallback-model-small for affected tenants.

ops-bot: Running commands recommended:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# apply runtime flag to prefillservice
redwoodctl runtime set-flag prefill.max_window=4096 --pool prefills
```

dmitri-ml: option (2) will reduce OOMs with minimal code change. I'll assemble a hotpatch to short-circuit prefill path for sequences > 4096 so we skip KV warmup. Deployable as runtime patch 2a9f.

mike-oncall: mike-oncall here — going to apply prefill.max_window=4096 to pool prefills now. starting cordon/drain on node-17.

lana-sre: node-17 drained, restarting pods onto nodes with larger headroom. watch for warmup latency after redeploy.

ops-bot: Scaling up new nodes in us-west-2: +3 g4dn instances, prewarm disabled.

emily-cs: CS: customers ACorp and BetaApps reported errors; drafting a short update: "We're mitigating an outage affecting long-context requests; engineering is active, temporary limits applied, will update in 30m."

mike-oncall: hotpatch 2a9f rolled to prefills pool (canary 10%). Observed immediate drop in OOMs on canary pods.

dmitri-ml: logs from canary show prefill skip on >4096 path and successful fallback streaming. no OOMs in 10m sampling.

lana-sre: continuing drain of node-21 now. keep an eye on backlog and retry queues.

emily-cs: posting status page update and pinging affected accounts.

mike-oncall: next steps: 1) promote hotpatch to 100% (in 10m if no regressions) 2) keep prefill.max_window=4096 for 24h, collect perf and quality metrics 3) run postmortem triage for long-window validity and consider graceful prefill-trimming vs coldmodel fallback.

dmitri-ml: will add evals to measure quality drop for trimming >4k tokens and propose config for tenant opt-in.

lana-sre: monitoring: no new OOM restarts in last 12 minutes; error-rate trending down to baseline.

emily-cs: I'll schedule customer follow-ups and record affected request IDs.

mike-oncall: thanks team — I'll keep the thread open for status updates. tagging SRE rotation for postmortem. :lock:
